test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The TV _____________ of the incident was extremely poor.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Coverage". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Coverage" **specifically refers to the treatment of news or information in media, making it the most suitable choice for this context.
 
• The other options do not naturally fit in the context of media reporting or the manner in which an event is broadcast or shared with the audience.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is "Option 1".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Coverage: **Refers specifically to the way in which news and events are reported by the media.
 
• **Scope: **While it relates to the extent or range of something, it doesn't specifically address the quality of media reporting.
 
• **Compassing: **Not a standard term in the context of media reporting.
 
• **Sweeping: **Describes broad actions or statements, not the quality of reporting.
